maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for INC-5423 — link: https://intranet.redwood/postmortem/INC-5423 :eyes:
maya: TL;DR: recurring KV-cache eviction pattern -> intermittent latency spikes. Action items: update runbook triage steps, add exact commands, add escalation path (on-call -> infra lead -> exec on-call), and schedule a short remediation sprint. Please ack with owner + target date by EOD today.

sanjay: I can own the runbook triage step edits. Will add a checklist and the commands. Target: 2026-03-25 (Wednesday).
evan: I'll take the escalation path and the 'when to escalate' policy. Target: 2026-03-26. Suggest: escalate if same eviction signature occurs 3x in 24h or impacts p99 latency > 200ms.
tess: Can someone paste the exact kubectl and evict commands so I can test them in staging?
sanjay: Adding snippets here — put these in the runbook under "triage -> collect logs" and "mitigate -> force-evict" sections:```kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-runtime --since=30m | grep -i KVCachekubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}' | xargs -I{} kubectl -n inference exec -it {} -- /bin/sh -c 'curl -sS localhost:9090/debug/cache/evict'```

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-7891 and linked to the postmortem: https://tickets.redwood/INF-7891 (runbook edits + sprint task)

luca: I'll block 2 developer-days in next sprint for runbook review + staging run. Will review PRs once created.

maya: Thanks everyone. Please attach your PR links to the postmortem doc and tag them with `postmortem-followup` and `runbook-update`. If any owner needs more time, say so now. :thumbsup:

sanjay: FYI I ran the evict flow in staging, no side effects. I'll open PR by EOD Monday and link it.

(3 days later)
sanjay: PR merged: https://git.redwood/runbooks/commit/4f2a9a — added steps, commands, and a short troubleshooting checklist. Marking INF-7891 as in-review -> done.

maya: Awesome — closing the loop. Can we add a recurring monitor to detect the pattern (3x in 24h) and create automated paging to infra if threshold crossed? Putting that as follow-up task on INF-7891.
ev an: noted, I'll spike a monitor and report back next week.

luca: Confirmed: runbook updated, sprint allocation consumed, and incident follow-ups tracked in INF-7891. Thanks team! :party:
